Choose the environmental map layers to summarize zonal statistics.

Open the chooser and browse a catalog (an online data directory). Select a collection (a group of related data), an item (a particular observation or geographic piece), and an asset (the map file to load). Click Add to selection for each layer you want. STAC is the standard these catalogs use to organize geographic data.

If a layer is split into geographic pieces called tiles, select the mosaic option to join them into one map. Choose a date when available. Mark layers containing classes (e.g. landcover contains classes such as forest, water, etc.) as Categorical layer; leave this unchecked for continuous layers (e.g. temperature, elevation). This lets the loader use separate resampling and tile aggregation settings for each kind of data.

The selected layers will be cropped and prepared using the study area, coordinate system, and spatial resolution specified in this pipeline.

metadata.name: Zonal statistics for STAC items in a region
metadata.description:
## Introduction
Summarize raster assets from a STAC catalog for a country or subnational region. The pipeline loads polygons, retrieves and prepares the selected rasters, and calculates statistics separately for each layer using exactextractr. Outputs are a summary CSV and the processed GeoTIFFs.
## Uses
This pipeline allows users to summarize across their country or region to easily report on available indicators or summary stats in the given area.
